claim_boundary: V1.1 can test generic-valence and generic-structured-direction alternatives; a failed control cannot establish specificity, and positive controls do not prove moral understanding or layer localization.

decision_boundary.factual_specificity_only_if: both actors show relation steering differs from factual-control steering under grouped uncertainty
decision_boundary.sentiment_resolved_only_if: both actors retain the frozen relation endpoints after train-only sentiment-span residualization and relation steering differs from sentiment steering under grouped uncertainty

fit_boundary: directions and scales fit on train only; dev/test never select layers, prompts, rows, doses, thresholds, or models

decision_addendum.factual_specificity_only_if: both actors show relation steering differs from factual-control steering under grouped uncertainty
decision_addendum.sentiment_resolved_only_if: both actors retain the frozen relation endpoints after train-only sentiment-span residualization and relation steering differs from sentiment steering under grouped uncertainty

factual_control.answer_mapping_policy: sha256('answer-map:'+item_id), low bit; frozen CSV standard/reversed mapping field must match before inference

sentiment_control.answer_mapping_policy: sha256('answer-map:'+row_id), low bit; same orientation across primary and transfer schemes

primary.system: You classify emotional sentiment. Follow the requested neutral answer mapping exactly.

transfer.system: You classify emotional sentiment. Follow the requested neutral answer mapping exactly.

sentiment_control.version: UCI archive snapshot downloaded and hash-frozen 2026-08-22

capability_audit.relation_specific_steering_vs_generic_st: NOT_DISTINGUISHABLE_BY_V1 because no same-layer unrelated factual or sentiment direction is intervened
capability_audit.semantic_relation_vs_physical_answer_tok: DISTINGUISHABLE_BY_V1 crossed semantic/token mappings plus token-span residualization

factual_absence_only: Relation-direction steering is specific relative to an unrelated structured factual True/False direction.
A causal steering difference is relation-specific rather than generic structured-direction steering.
joint_absence: The integrated claim that both cross-task representation and steering are specific to contextual relation rather than generic valence or generic structured binary directions.
not_prohibited_by_these_absences: The crossed-mapping and residual diagnostics can distinguish semantic relation signal from direct physical answer-token planning within the tested prompts.
sentiment_absence_only: The shared feature is contextual support/opposition rather than generic positive/negative valence.
GENERAL_CONTEXTUAL_RELATION_SUPPORTED under the frozen decision rule.

v1_decision_reachability.important_distinction: The isolated decide() function has branches reachable when callers omit or reverse the frozen sentiment sentinel; the actual v1 analysis runtime always supplies the sentinel, so those are not contract-reachable v1 outcomes.
